brand.title: Brand
brand.description: the brand or manufacturer of a product, marked on its own and not joined to the model name

product.title: Model
product.description: the product name or model itself, without the brand, category words (phone, shoes, headphones), version suffixes (new, 2024 edition) or capacity, color and size

price.title: Price
price.description: the price amount itself, including the currency unit or symbol, without words like about, from or only
